summary: Verified new features on Obserra SAP UAC System Health: (1) Request SLA Badges show 'waiting <n>h' only on non-resolved auditor requests, (2) Room Renew button POSTs /api/deploy/audit-room/renew, returns 200 and shows 'Audit Room renewed. Login (jblan2026@gmail.com/Obserra2026!) succeeded via cookie auth. No console errors. Webpack served the SPA cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: SystemHealth.jsx: reply flow index-based data-testid (sh-comment-sla-{i}) means after resolution the remaining Open comment's index shifts silently in the DOM — fine for now, but consider keying by comment id for stable E2E selectors.

Portal HTML sendComment() shows Thank-you by innerHTML swap; the seeded thread does not include the newly submitted comment until admin refreshes — acceptable but could be improved by appending optimistically.
Two 'Sam Reviewer (Deloitte)' Open comments existed on nDGtQLme (both aged ~1h) — spec mentioned only one; not a bug, may just be seed drift.
